description: This file defines the Drupal form class 'FieldStorageConfigEditForm' for editing field storage configurations within the Drupal 'field_ui' module. It includes methods for building the form, validating cardinality, and managing entity data related to field storage settings.

classes.name: FieldStorageConfigEditForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for editing field storage configurations, providing UI and validation logic for field cardinality and storage settings.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate the form with the 'typed_data_manager' service.

methods.name: getEntityFromRouteMatch
methods.description: Retrieves the field storage entity based on the route parameter, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, loading the field config and setting entity type and bundle in form state.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Defines the form elements, including cardinality settings and storage options.

methods.name: getCardinalityForm
methods.description: Constructs the sub-form for setting allowed number of values.

methods.name: validateCardinality
methods.description: Validates the user input for field cardinality, ensuring consistency with existing data.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Prepares the entity data before saving, especially handling cardinality values.

methods.name: getEnforcedCardinality
methods.description: Returns the fixed cardinality enforced by the field type, if any.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Overrides default actions, returning an empty array.
